purpose: Desktop rainy island and companion-room window; no baked precipitation. Runtime time, rain and motion stay independent.

assets.prompt: Edit WEATHER AND LIGHT ONLY in this detailed pastel pixel-art landscape used outside a cozy companion-room window. implementation: New versioned files. Same source dimensions and panorama anchors; selected scene is never overwritten by rain. Dusk uses the day overcast file with warm runtime grading. Original environment masks continue moving clouds, islands and water.
limitations: Artwork editing approximates original pixels rather than guaranteeing every plant is identical. The project retains the user's existing source-rights boundary; no new third-party downloads or license claims.
